steps.name: Memento mori (1)
steps.objective: Meet [Lif] in front of the bench in 「Lifthrasir」, talk to her, and complete the quest.

lines.text: (Warm sunlight from a clear, cloudless sky shines on Lifthrasir's plaza.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wanted a good night's sleep...
(Sitting on a bench with your head tilted back toward the sky, you see a mischievous elf enter %s's field of vision.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: What are you doing, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Director. Just spacing out.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: So you were resting. I hope I wasn't interrupting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. As you suggested, simply resting does feel nice.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Was your lodging uncomfortable?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. It's just that I have a lot on my mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You may already know... I've experienced many things on my travels. Some worked out well, but others remain unresolved.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You have many worries. Don't push yourself too hard trying to solve everything right now. Some things work themselves out when the time is right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's true. But perhaps because I'm impatient, it isn't easy.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Try to let go of those lingering uneasy feelings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Where have you been, Director?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Out for a little walk. I made a circuit of the forest and the village. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You look so silly slumped there. It's delightful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sometimes you say such harsh things so naturally, Director. It's almost admirable.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll take that as a compliment. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong, Director?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, a moment. There's something I'd like to discuss. Would you come to the front of my house?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Director.

steps.name: Memento mori (2)
steps.objective: See what is happening in the restricted area of 「Crystal Moon Forest」, then turn in the quest to [Feta] in 「Orcarium」.

lines.text: (Lif's expression, so bright and playful moments ago, has hardened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The forest is grieving.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The forest is grieving?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: That may sound strange to you, %s, but after living in Lifthrasir for so long, I can feel the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean you can sense something like the forest's energy?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I should check... %s, do you have a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'm free right now.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Then follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are we going?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Come along, and you'll see.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Just as I thought...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something wrong here? Oh... I didn't see this last time, but the petals have changed color. Why...?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The leaves and petals of the Crystal Moon Forest have never changed color, from the day I was born until now.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: They were fine even when demons coveted this place long ago... It's only a few flowers now, but the number will grow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who could have done this to the forest?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: If I only noticed it now... Hmm. Who on earth... Sigh, I don't know.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: For now, restoring the trees and flowers should come before finding the culprit. The method is simple, but there's a problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What problem?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: We need the energy of a tree that retains the power of spirits. From another region, not here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... I know a place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly tell Lif about Orcarium.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Orcarium? The place that awaited Orca, who was a demigod? I thought it existed only in oral tradition. How remarkable that it's real.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: We should be able to obtain the right energy there, though we may have to search several places.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do we bring back this spirit energy?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There is a kind of magic paper that prevents magic from escaping an enchanted object.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Like protective wrapping for magic...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like something from the Magic Bureau. Is it safe to use?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's all right. Its safety is guaranteed, so both the empire and Alfheim use it from time to time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Now, %s. Lead the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: We don't have time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Follow me, then. I don't know a direct route from here, so we'll go through Knossos.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Good!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, Director...?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is something of a crisis, so why do you seem to be enjoying yourself?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It'll be wonderful if the flowers and trees recover.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I mean besides that.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Who knows? I suppose I'm simply happy to go out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Really...? She does this so often I can't tell what's sincere.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe. %s, shall we get going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're ready, let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh... We'll have to pass through the camp to reach Orcarium.)

steps.name: Memento mori (3)
steps.objective:
1. Explore a quiet spot in 「Orcarium」.
2. Defeat [El-Larsa] in 「Spirit Stump」 and obtain the <Tree Ring Rubbing>. Then return to 「Lifthrasir」 and turn in the quest to [Lif].

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yawn... I'm sleepy. And hungry... Why is there nothing to eat here...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're still here, Feta.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Still here? Adventurer, have you been here before?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: And where did you come from? Every passage into this place has been blocked.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Well, you must have found some way.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Under imperial law, only people connected with the Magic Bureau may pass through here at present.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Please wait until the other members of the Bureau arrive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Feta. What are you talking about? I've been here before.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: This is the first time I've seen you here...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Huh... What? I was definitely captured by No Name...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. No Name is alive?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: No Name was asking how he had survived, then said he was going to catch a witch...

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Why are my memories all mixed up?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: ...It's not as though I met a witch.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Oh! Is it because I'm hungry?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Feta's memories have been distorted. I don't know whether what happened after Narsha and I left was real...)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, did a witch appear in Orcarium?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, but... Sigh.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: This mage seems fine now.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: You there, elf. What brings you here? This isn't a place just anyone can...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Could you help us investigate here for a little while?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: You need permission... Even the adventurer can't enter again right now. Even with His Majesty's orders... Ugh. Ah... I'm hungry.
(Lif looks amused at Feta clutching her empty stomach with a grimace.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Are you hungry?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I have lots of special cookies made in Lifthrasir. What do you say? Want to try one?

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: ...Lifthrasir's special cookies? Starlight Cookies?
(Lif nods and reaches into a small bag.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do elves have lots of bags like that?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe, not many, but some of us have them. Now, Ms. Mage. Help us do a quick investigation, and I'll give you lots of Alfheim cookies.
(Feta considers it seriously. But only for a moment: she takes the cookie waving before her eyes and bites into it.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Only a little while, right?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Of course. Here. You can eat them all.
(Feta gasps in admiration as Lif sets out numerous wrapped boxes of Starlight Cookies.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Will she ever make it to headquarters if food wins her over so easily? Sigh. Speaking of which, I should take Michaela some Starlight Cookies sometime.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, if there's an unusual place among the parts of Orcarium you've visited, take me there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will she be all right?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It seems meeting you woke her up, as it did us... I don't see any major problem. She's a Magic Bureau mage. She'll manage. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Will she recover if we leave her alone, as Director Lif says? Still, it's strange. How did what happened in Lifthrasir affect things all the way here...?)
(As %s turns over many thoughts, an unknown shadow falls behind you. A gentle touch, accompanied by someone's strangely familiar power...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No. Then this is...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wh-Who are you?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What are you saying?)
(The black shadow grows, as though swallowing %s's sight.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, let's go.
(The moment the adventurer turns at Lif's voice, the black shadow filling the surroundings scatters like bubbles.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-What was that?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: ...What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: You look a little tired. I'm sorry. It's because of me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's nothing like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I didn't imagine hearing that, did I...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... Director, let's finish quickly and leave this place.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: All right. If you feel unwell along the way, tell me at once.
(%s stops in the quiet part of Orcarium where you met No Name.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Is this where you met that boy? You've really been through a great deal, %s.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's also surprising that a spirit who guided travelers ended up like that. And then you came to our village?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I met a witch, following His Majesty's foresight.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I haven't accompanied you from the beginning of your journey, %s, so I can't know everything...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: But if you need anything in the future, always tell me. I'll help as much as I can. I say that as the village's representative, so it may prove useful someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Director. What do you think of this place?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: One moment. Hmm...
(Lif quietly closes her eyes and takes a deep breath.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: This place does feel special, but there aren't many plants from which we can take suitable energy.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The spirit energy seems concentrated over there. Let's go that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's... toward the Spirit's Stump... Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Follow me, Director.
(Before the Spirit's Stump, the entrance that %s remembered collapsing still stands intact.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did Geis and Harmonia restore it? It seems we might be able to enter.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Can we go inside?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We can, but... There are spirits who don't allow outsiders. It could be dangerous.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe, don't underestimate an elf.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say it's all right, I'll trust you. Follow me.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Yes. Don't worry too much.
(Deep within the Spirit's Stump, where you met Ell-Larsa, the remains of what was once the spirit tree greet you both.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Thanks to you, %s, we made it all the way here. And we found a tree filled with such wonderful energy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad we arrived without trouble.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: But this place...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It is sorrow itself.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: So much pain and sorrow seem to remain. Perhaps that is true everywhere, but here especially...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Let's cast those feelings aside, achieve our goal, and return!
(As soon as she finishes speaking, Lif takes paper from her clothes and lays it on the stump. A mysterious light rises around it.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'll offer a short prayer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can do?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Nothing in particular. Just watch.
(Lif kneels, closes her eyes, and prays. The light circling the paper gradually fades.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She prayed in words I couldn't understand. Is it finished now?)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: All done. When I lift it like this, the good energy remains in the paper.
(As Lif lifts and unfolds the paper, the stump's growth rings appear clearly on it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The growth rings are imprinted exactly. Amazing.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hmm...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, there isn't anyone here besides the two of us, is there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No one. Did you sense something?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: If this were Lifthrasir, I would know at once. Hmm. If you don't know either, %s, then it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did she sense that shadow too? It didn't seem like that...)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Now, shall we return? You can sort out your thoughts back in Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Director.

steps.name: Memento mori (4)
steps.objective:
1. Talk to Jeril in 「Song of the Vanished Star」, then defeat [Merlin] to obtain the <Source of Ominous Enchantment>.
Press the [Complete Quest button] in the reward room to automatically begin the next quest.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Everything worked out thanks to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon? We haven't done anything since returning to Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: The moment we returned, the pure energy we obtained in Orcarium had already flowed into the Crystal Moon Forest.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Here, look.
(Lif holds up the paper that bore the rubbing of the growth rings. The rings have vanished without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you're right. Have the plants in the restricted area recovered?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I don't think we need to go check right now.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Whew... It feels like it's been ages since I went outside Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But who could have done it?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Anyone who could tamper with the Crystal Moon Forest without my noticing must be extraordinary.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, I don't know. I'll rest for now. You should eat and rest at your lodgings too, %s. Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to your kindness, I'll rest well, Director Lif. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe. Then you'll spend your retirement here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I still have my whole life ahead of me!

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Yes, it must be wonderful to be so young. I'll be going in, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She got me good. Sigh. Time to get some rest...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Why are you here...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I can't rest.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It's been a while. Can't you greet me a little more warmly? Have you forgotten ours is no ordinary relationship?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What relationship...?
(Smiling, Jeril approaches %s and whispers his purpose so softly it is barely audible.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: We need to talk. Come inside the [Vanished Song of the Stars]. Alone and quietly. Otherwise, who knows what I might do to you?
(The moment his boyishly innocent smile deepens into something cruel, Jeril scatters and vanishes like a shadow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth does he want to say...?
(Inside the Vanished Song of the Stars, another familiar person besides Jeril watches you with an unwelcoming expression.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno will explain the details.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Why do I have to...?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Because you care about Iris...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Be quiet...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Then listen carefully.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Were you the ones who contaminated the plants...?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I have never done that, nor do I wish to. I have no time, either... I don't know whether this will answer your question.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: The black moon desires light.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The black moon...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: You must have sensed it vaguely. An ancient god who has remained hidden, yet has been obstructing your path and Iris's.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Awakened in the space of eternity, watching Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: That being does not wish its name to be spoken by sinners like us.
(As Kazno and Jeril silently look up at the sky, a darkness that was absent moments ago begins pouring in.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: The black moon's power is trying to silence us. I'll meet you at the place you'll soon visit and explain the details there.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: We cannot speak of it here now.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Well done, Kazno.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Oh, %s. There's something you'll need to do for us. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: If this darkness grows any thicker, the Vanished Song of the Stars will cease to exist. And then all of Lifthrasir...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Find and destroy the objects in the places where those connected to the witch were. They should be able to send this darkness back.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It should be here and at the cathedral. Fascinating, though. A combination of demons and witches...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: %s, I don't want your help, but we have no choice. Please survive.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: For Iris's sake...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Heh. That's what makes Kazno so charming. %s, farewell until we meet again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-Wait! We haven't finished talking!!
(Kazno and Jeril say their goodbyes on their own terms and vanish where they stand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The witches are already enough to deal with. Why must there be a god obstructing Iris too...?
(As though it has heard the resentful voice, the darkness deepens.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. There's no time for this. Let's find those objects quickly.
(At a dead end in the Vanished Song of the Stars, a small purple crystal glitters.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems to contain powerful magic. Did it belong to Merlin?
「Even if you call it a god's blessing, the power you possess now was gained at the cost of someone's death...」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why am I remembering Merlin's words? Sigh... Ignore it and destroy this...
(The moment you approach the crystal, the surrounding black shadows move in as though to stop you. But %s's weapon shatters it first.)
(As the crystal breaks, the dense shadows circling the Vanished Song of the Stars scatter like dust and disappear as though they had never been.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know who commands these shadows, but things won't go your way...
「At least beg for your life before death, like the other hypocrites. That would be a better choice.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Merlin's words keep coming back...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ignore it. There's no time to stay here. Hurry to the cathedral.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Quickly... I have to get to the cathedral.

steps.name: Memento mori (5)
steps.objective:
In 「Twilight Cathedral」, defeat [Mordred] to obtain the <Arthur Doll>, and defeat [Morgana] to obtain the <Pendant of Collapse>.
Then press the [Complete Quest button] in the reward room to finish the quest.

lines.text: (You rush anxiously to the Twilight Cathedral, but only silence fills it, as though no one is there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No shadows. All right. If there's something connected to Morgana, I need to find it quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me I have to go all the way to the upper chapel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I knew it wouldn't be easy. Let's go.
(In a corner of the upper chapel where you fought Morgana, you find a pendant that seems to belong to her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I definitely destroyed Morgana's pendant. Why is there another one here...? As though it had been waiting...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh, I don't know. Just destroy the doll and pendant quickly...
(As you move to destroy the doll of a familiar figure and the pendant, dense shadows flow in from somewhere.)
「Everything you believed in may collapse in an instant.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Now Morgana's voice too...? Don't get in my way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Destroy this...
「Right and wrong no longer matter.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop it! I said stop!
(The moment the adventurer's attack strikes the shadow trying to prevent the destruction, an enormous shock wave shakes the silent cathedral.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...
(As the dust filling the chapel settles, bright light streams through the windows. Raising your head, %s sees no trace of the doll or pendant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it done? There's nothing left, so it must be over, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Let's go back.
(As %s turns to leave, a vast shadow rises slowly from the floor and takes human form before you.)
(From within the shadow comes the voice of an unknown being, mingled with the voice of someone you once heard.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: 「Were the monsters that died in this [▒▒] truly [▒] that you had every right to hunt?」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This voice...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?!
「Master of the black moon and ▒▒, and of those who await the night.」
「You are no god. Remember that you will die. As long as you do not forget that, nothing will happen.」
(With those words, the voice filled with all the world's twisted emotions falls silent. The shadows that filled the chapel withdraw and disappear as well.)
